text:
A bar magnet can be demagnetised by hammering it for a long time or by slowly removing it from
a coil connected to a power supply.
Which row completes the descriptions of how these processes are carried out?
hammering bar magnet
slowly removing bar magnet
for a long time with
from a coil connected to

a d.c. power supply
B
magnet aligned E-W
an a.c. power supply
C
magnet aligned N-S
a d.c. power supply
D
magnet aligned N-S
an a.c. power supply
